original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳议员Baffour Awuah涉EOCO案件重启Equity Savings & Loans档案，SIC追偿之争浮现
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据议员称，加纳经济与有组织犯罪办公室（EOCO）对Baffour Awuah的案件调查，与其律所为SIC Life Savings and Loans Company Limited提供法律服务、试图从Equity Savings and Loans追回数百万塞地有关。该案重启了Equity Savings & Loans的相关档案，并牵出SIC的追偿之争。上述关联为议员单方面说法，目前仅有一个来源报道，尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 加纳议员称EOCO对Baffour Awuah的案件调查与其律所为SIC Life Savings and Loans追偿Equity Savings and Loans有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to the MP, the investigation is connected to legal work his firm carried out for SIC Life Savings and Loans Company Limited in an attempt to recover millions of cedis from Equity Savings and Loans.

key_facts.fact: 该案重启了Equity Savings & Loans档案，并牵出SIC追偿之争
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Baffour Awuah’s EOCO case reopens Equity Savings & Loans file as SIC recovery battle emerges

uncertainties: 案件与SIC追偿的关联仅为议员单方面说法，尚未证实
目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，缺乏交叉验证
